page.notes: Page number read as 438 from a heavily worn "43$" at the head; the last digit is the most doubtful. The running head is set with letter spacing. "ceffaverit" is partly obscured by a ligature, so the final letters are uncertain. The line "Actor.2." is placed at the left under the paragraph and is treated as a marginal reference. The left and right margins hold only dashes and specks, which are not transcribed. "fi-lium" was printed as "fi‡lium" with a mark that may be a hyphen; it is written as "filium". Catchword "nim" is at the bottom right.
